set.body:
Problem:
NiftiResponseBlockSource currently issues at least one positional FileChannel.read per selected timepoint/voxel pair. A 200 TR by 50k voxel block therefore drives roughly ten million tiny positional reads.

Scope:
- Build a package-private read plan from (voxel index, requested output column) pairs.
- Sort by storage position, coalesce contiguous spans, merge bounded small gaps when cheaper than another read, and split at an explicit maximum window size.
- For each requested timepoint, bulk-read each planned window into one reusable correctly ordered ByteBuffer.
- Decode only selected offsets and scatter values back into the caller's original voxel order.
- Retain Long position arithmetic, readFully partial/EOF handling, datatype scaling, and bounded allocation.
- Add an opt-in representative benchmark that reports selected voxels, windows, positional read calls, bytes read, throughput, and buffer size.

Acceptance:
- A full spatial selection plans one window and normally one positional read per requested timepoint.
- A deterministic dense brain-mask-like selection uses orders of magnitude fewer windows than selected voxels.
- Widely separated sparse voxels remain separate bounded windows rather than forcing an unbounded enclosing read.
- Requested voxel order (including descending/noncontiguous order) and requested timepoint order are preserved exactly.
- Window byte sizes and arithmetic are overflow-checked; truncated data returns DatasetError.StorageFailure.
- The reusable read buffer is bounded by configured maximum window bytes, not study voxel count or number of timepoints.
- datasetJVM/test passes and the new planner tests assert read counts structurally rather than relying on noisy wall-clock thresholds.
set.title: NIfTI hot path: coalesce voxel reads into bounded byte windows
